Padding changes every packed-A address and adds scratch traffic; the two packed-B proposals both add a 1 MiB buffer and timed packing, so they have greater cost and implementation risk. Transpose fusion repeats A reads across column panels. The A-transpose fusion targets fallback sizes, not the fixed n=512 panel32 path. Prior active-path scheduling and pipeline measurements were variable and did not pass promotion; they do not establish causality or predict these distinct proposals.
